name: Question 1
problem:
A storage tank initially holds $400\,\text{L}$ of liquid containing $3\,\text{kg}$ of dissolved disinfectant.
A solution containing $0.03\,\text{kg/L}$ of dissolved disinfectant is pumped into the tank at a rate of $20\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed liquid is drained out at a rate of $20\,\text{L/min}.$ Which expression gives the amount of disinfectant $Q(t),$ in kilograms, in the tank $t$ minutes after pumping begins?

html:
Question 1
?

A storage tank initially holds 400L of liquid containing 3kg of dissolved disinfectant. A solution containing 0.03kg/L of dissolved disinfectant is pumped into the tank at a rate of 20L/min, while the completely mixed liquid is drained out at a rate of 20L/min. Which expression gives the amount of disinfectant Q(t), in kilograms, in the tank t minutes after pumping begins?

a
Q(t)=12−9e−t/20
b
Q(t)=−9+12e−t/20
c
Q(t)=4−e−t/20
d
Q(t)=10−7et/20
e
Q(t)=−1+4et/20
Submit
